steps.ask: Why should a thank-you note be specific?

explain.say: Imagine opening an envelope and finding a note that says exactly why you are special to someone. Notes like that can be kept for years! Let us write one together. Look at the board: start with a greeting, like, Dear Grandpa.

explain.say: Next, say thank you: thank you for the football. Then be specific: I played with it all weekend! See the star? Being specific shows you really mean it. What gift would you write about?

explain.say: Now share a feeling: it made me so happy. And end warmly: see you soon, love, Aisha. Look, five little parts and your note is done! Which part feels easiest?

faq.q: What should a thank-you note say?
faq.a: A greeting, a thank you, something specific about the gift or help, how it made you feel, and a warm ending with your name.
asks: Tell me about the Say thank you
How do I write a thank-you card?

faq.q: Why should a thank-you note be specific?
faq.a: Specific words, like I wear the scarf every day, show you really noticed and care. It makes the note feel personal.
asks: Tell me about the Be specific

faq.a: They show people their kindness made a difference. Notes can be kept and read again, and they make both people feel good.
asks: Tell me about the Grandpa reads it

faq.q: Who should I write a thank-you note to?
faq.a: Anyone who was kind to you: someone who gave a gift, a teacher, a coach, a neighbour, a nurse, or a friend who helped.
asks: Can I thank my teacher with a note?

faq.q: Can I send a thank-you message instead?
faq.a: Yes, a message or voice note is lovely too, especially for faraway family. A handwritten note can feel extra special because it takes time.
asks: Is a text okay for saying thanks?

facts: In a 2018 study, Amit Kumar and Nicholas Epley found people writing thank-you letters underestimated how pleased the readers would feel.
Writing letters of gratitude is a common exercise used by psychologists to boost happiness.

quiz.say: Which sentence makes a thank-you note specific?

options.show: "I wore your blue scarf to school every day this week!"
options.say: "I wore your blue scarf to school every day this week!"

quiz.why: It names exactly how you used and enjoyed the gift.

wrong.2: "Bye" is an ending, not a thank you.

quiz.say: What comes at the very start of a note?
quiz.why: A greeting tells who the note is for.

wrong.1: Your name goes at the end.
wrong.2: The note starts with who it is for.
